1. **[id 67ab314c-5a13-4a89-b35f-6e9537e74c71-89189]**: Deficiency of insulin impairs glucose uptake, leading to diabetes mellitus (বহুমূত্র). **(B)**
2. **[id 68569189-0bf1-4a15-ae3f-60f829a88ebb-79778]**: Sclerenchyma cells are dead and lack protoplasm/chloroplasts, so having chloroplasts is incorrect. **(C)**
3. **[id 6933878d-b2f3-4939-b07e-1ce5d40c908c-20187]**: The minor of entry $(1,2)$ is $(-1)(4) - (6)(7) = -46$. Thus, the cofactor is $(-1)^{1+2}(-46) = 46$. **(C)**
4. **[id 6dac6d45-aa1a-4ca2-9137-ed74ad8d1311-71046]**: Molar mass of $\text{CaCl}_2 \approx 111\text{ g/mol}$. In $0.015\text{ M}$, concentration $= 0.015 \times 111 = 1.665\text{ g/L} = 1665\text{ ppm}$. **(A)**
5. **[id 6ee561d5-27e9-47c7-a614-9752b1d8cc15-80683]**: Perpendicular distance to the line is $d = \frac{|4(2) + 3(3) - 7|}{\sqrt{4^2+3^2}} = \frac{10}{5} = 2$. The distance from the point to its image point is $2d = 4\text{ units}$. **(B)**
6. **[id 71f25bf8-a76a-466d-bc74-007ef39e7c15-128717]**: The oil painting 'পঞ্চইন্দ্রিয়' (Five Senses) in general knowledge contexts was painted by M. F. Husain (মকবুল ফিদা হোসেন). **(B)**
7. **[id 72b547d4-bb13-45ee-98e7-16dc6fc75a49-44147]**: Due to decreasing bond dissociation energy down the group, $\text{HI}$ is the strongest hydrohalic acid. **(D)**
8. **[id 7365fff4-3ba8-4efb-ac67-5a7940463525-14949]**: For simple harmonic oscillation of a simple pendulum, the angular displacement must not exceed $4^\circ$ ($\sin\theta \approx \theta$). **(B)**
9. **[id 752de91a-4a2e-4c17-b275-f73ebde26e01-59185]**: Apparent frequency $f' = f \frac{v}{v + v_s} = 120 \times \frac{320}{320 + 15} \approx 114.6\text{ Hz}$. **(C)**
10. **[id 753d2e4a-c542-4740-b5ad-a0a57b2f1d35-81591]**: The time period depends on the effective length ($T = 2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$). **(C)**
11. **[id 75d8ee9a-0dc3-48b1-8322-82fd3c602292-7886]**: The duration of atrial systole in the cardiac cycle is $0.1\text{ s}$. **(C)**
12. **[id 7618488d-de61-4487-ada3-2eb2618165d7-84216]**: The objective function $z = 7x + 9y$ subject to $x+2y \le 8, 2x+y \le 10, x,y \ge 0$ achieves its maximum at the vertex $(4,2)$, where $z = 7(4) + 9(2) = 46$. **(B)**
13. **[id 764f6eda-81b0-45a0-bb6d-44c26c53782e-7306]**: Earth's average surface temperature due to the greenhouse effect of the atmosphere is approximately $15^\circ\text{C}$. **(C)**
14. **[id 7690d276-0c68-4558-8bec-453730563cce-1991]**: For principal quantum number $n = 3$, the azimuthal quantum number $l$ can only take values $0, 1, 2$. Therefore, $l = 3$ is not possible. **(A)**
15. **[id 76d2d03f-237f-4d28-82a5-1607191c62e2-121114]**: Vascular bundles are classified as radial (অরীয়), conjoint/collateral (সমপার্শ্বীয়), and concentric (কেন্দ্রিক). 'প্রতিসম' (symmetrical) is not a type of vascular bundle. **(D)**
